summary: Iteration 7 frontend-only verification of IntersectionObserver/ResizeObserver polyfill fixes for CAFE DEL NORD. Ran 5 environment scenarios (normal, no IO, no RO, no IO+RO, no IO+RO+localStorage-blocked) across /, /menu, /galeri and full regression on /, /menu, /galeri, /hakkimizda, /iletisim, /rezervasyon. In EVERY scenario: no error-boundary rendered, no pageerror events, hero/menu/gallery content rendered. Interactive checks: menu search filters cards (1 result for 'kum'), gallery lightbox opens on click (32 items), reservation form and inputs present. Bug fixes verified working.

issues: Uses browser-native HTML5 date/time picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of shadcn Calendar component — inconsistent styling with dark theme and poor UX on some browsers

action_items: (Optional) Replace native <input type=date/time> on /rezervasyon with shadcn Calendar + time popover for consistent branded UX
critical_code_review_comments: index.js polyfill approach is correct: intersection-observer imported (self-installing side-effect) and ResizeObserver assigned only when missing — safe order before App import.
App.js Lenis init properly wrapped in try/catch with rafId cleanup — no leak if Lenis constructor throws.
ErrorBoundary correctly exposes error-detail testid for future diagnostics; message truncation via break-words is good.
Global 'error' listener suppressing ResizeObserver loop noise is fine but consider also 'unhandledrejection' for framer-motion async cases.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Polyfills for IntersectionObserver + ResizeObserver are in place in /app/frontend/src/index.js. ErrorBoundary shows error-detail testid. Rate limit /api/reservations = 5/5min per IP — avoid multiple submissions during testing. When taking Playwright screenshots use jpeg (or omit quality) — png+quality param errors.
rca of the issue: Previously users on webviews lacking IntersectionObserver hit ReferenceError inside framer-motion whileInView, escalating to ErrorBoundary. Fix installs intersection-observer polyfill (auto-shims window.IntersectionObserver on import) and conditionally assigns resize-observer-polyfill when native ResizeObserver missing. Lenis now try/catch guards prevent RO absence from breaking mount. Verified: with delete window.IntersectionObserver & delete window.ResizeObserver init scripts, hero+featured+menu+gallery render cleanly with zero pageerrors.
